AMOC.note: WHY THIS WAS NOT COUNTED UNTIL 08-09-2026. The entry here used to record that recalc.py REFUSES because it was pinned to a workbook two editions old. That was true, and this gate ran the refusing file, read its refusal as AMOC's result, and excused it — so the live recalculator underneath was never run by the book and the 35% discrepancy was invisible. An unreadable result standing where a failing one belongs is [R-ENF-04], inside a gate written to prevent it. The study now declares SUPERSEDED_BY and this gate follows the declaration.
AMOC.reason: The DELIVERED workbook publishes a fair value of EGP 11.41 a share where the study publishes 17.63 — 35% below its own answer — across 1,867 disagreeing formula cells. THE ROOT IS ONE FORMULA AND IT IS NOT STALENESS: DCF!C33 builds gross profit as revenue less cost plus a flat margin shift, and reproduces a gross margin of 9.68% in year one where the model applies 12.43%. Everything upstream agrees — revenue, cost of sales, the base-year margin, the segment foot, the whole income statement — and everything downstream of row 33 inherits the gap. The relative and book lenses still reconcile; the DCF and normalised lenses do not. Re-pointing the builder at the model's margin path is a re-issue task on a delivered study, not a fix in passing.
AMOC.what_closes_it: build_xlsx_v5.py's DCF gross-profit formula reproducing the model's forecast margin path, then recalc_v5.py green

no_check.XPT: no recalculation script in the study directory.

note: Studies whose delivered workbook was not reconciled against the study when this gate was adopted (05-Sep-2026).
